SERVICE DOMAIN: Financial Accounting Business Area: Risk and Compliance | Business Domain: Regulations and Compliance ------------------------------------------------- Functional Pattern: Track [LITERAL, SD Overview] Generic Artifact: Log Asset Type: Financial Booking [LITERAL, SD Overview] Clase (BIAN Asset Type View): Intelligence Asset Type Regla: Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Financial Booking Log = Financial Booking + Log Control Record: Financial Booking Log [LITERAL, SD Overview]
Behavior Qualifiers (1): LedgerPosting
Service Operations (Action Terms) — principales de 7 publicadas: [Initiate] POST /FinancialAccounting/Initiate [Update] PUT /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Update [Control] PUT /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Control [Retrieve] GET /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Retrieve
Semantic API Endpoints: POST /FinancialAccounting/Initiate PUT /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Update PUT /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Control GET /FinancialAccounting/{id}/Retrieve
Definicion oficial (BIAN): The Financial Accounting Service Domain takes in financial facts and based on these, creates accounting instructions that will update the general ledger and sub ledger accounts
BANCO HORIZONTE — por que este dominio esta en el alcance: Lleva la contabilidad del banco: registra los hechos economicos y mantiene los acumulados. Capacidad que sirve: Contabilidad y Registro Financiero (Ledger) Actividades cubiertas (6): - PN-02.9 Registro contable del desembolso - PN-04.7 Registro contable - PN-10.1 Cierre de operaciones del dia - PN-10.2 Extraccion de datos del core y satelites - PN-10.3 Consolidacion manual en hojas de calculo - PN-10.5 Ajustes manuales y reclasificaciones
